_source:
A real 'Physical Education Scheme of Work, Term 1' (a real Zambian secondary school's Physical Education Department; the source's own teacher name and school name are not reproduced here per this app's standing sourcing policy) and the real, official Curriculum Development Centre 'Physical Education and Sport Teaching Module, Form 2 Term 3' (a genuine CDC publication, Lusaka 2026 -- no individual/school name to strip) were both shared with this project via Drive. This is a genuine gap fill: this app previously had no Physical Education Form 2 (CBC) content at all, only Form 1 and the OBC Grade 10-12 files. Cites the real official '2024 Physical Education and Sport Syllabus, Ordinary Secondary Education Form 1-4' with real page citations (Term 1: pp.26-29).

TERM 1 real week placement is from the school's own scheme (weeks 1-6, 8-11; week 7 mid-term and weeks 12-13 end-of-term exams excluded, consistent with this app's standing rule).

TERM 3 is built from the official CDC Teaching Module's own 3 real topics (2.9, 2.10, 2.11, in its own table-of-contents order) rather than a school-specific scheme, since the module is the authoritative source for what's actually taught this term and covers strictly more real content than any one school's own scheme -- no real per-topic week data was available from this specific source, so none is invented. A separate real school's own Term 3 scheme was also checked: its own real week 1-2 cover exactly 2.11 Entrepreneurship in Sports (matching this file's own content), and its weeks 3-13 are confirmed pure revision/mock-exam/practical-assessment weeks naming no further new topic -- consistent with (not contradicting) building this term from the fuller official module instead.

TERM 2 is deliberately not included -- no real source for it was available at the time this file was built.

Its own Content/Concept, Learning Activities, Strategies/Methods and Materials/Resources columns are omitted, consistent with the approach used for every other bundled subject in this app.

subject.name: Physical Education
subject.description: Physical Education syllabus, Form 1-4 (Curriculum Development Centre).

grade.name: Form 2
grade.phase: Secondary — the source scheme itself uses "Form 2" for this level under the 2023 CBC.

topics.name: 2.1 History of Physical Education and Sport

sub_topics.name: 2.1.1 History of Physical Education in ancient Greece

competencies.description: Exhibit knowledge of the history of Physical Education in ancient Greece

sub_topics.description: The origins and significance of P.E. in ancient Greece.

sub_topics.name: 2.1.2 Beliefs and origin of Olympic Games

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of the beliefs and the origin of Olympic Games

sub_topics.description: The origin, beliefs, and symbols of the ancient Olympic Games.

sub_topics.name: 2.2.1 First-aid

competencies.description: Exhibit knowledge on the types of sports injuries
Exhibit knowledge on causes and prevention of sports injuries

sub_topics.description: Types, causes, and prevention of sports injuries (chronic and acute).

sub_topics.name: 2.2.2 Reproductive Health

competencies.description: Explore ways in which HIV and AIDS can be transmitted during sports and games

sub_topics.description: Basic reproductive health; HIV/AIDS transmission and prevention in sports.

sub_topics.name: 2.3.1 Skill-related components
sub_topics.description: Skill-related fitness components: speed, agility, reaction time, etc.

sub_topics.name: 2.4.1 Complex gymnastics
sub_topics.description: Performing basic stunts on gymnastics apparatus (e.g. vault).

sub_topics.name: 2.5.1 Traditional games
sub_topics.description: Performing more complex or regional traditional games.

topics.name: 2.6 Organisation and Management of Games and Sports Events

sub_topics.name: 2.6.1 The Sports Structure in Zambia

competencies.description: Design a model of the sports structure in Zambia

sub_topics.description: The hierarchy and organisations in Zambian sports (MYS, NSCZ, NOCZ).

sub_topics.name: 2.6.2 Sports associations in Zambia

competencies.description: Demonstrate understanding of Sports associations in Zambia

sub_topics.description: Key national sports associations (FAZ, ZAVA, ZTTA).

sub_topics.name: 2.6.3 International Sports bodies

competencies.description: Demonstrate knowledge of International Sports Bodies

sub_topics.description: Major international sports bodies (FIFA, IOC, FIBA).

sub_topics.name: 2.9.1 Human Muscular System

competencies.description: Demonstrate knowledge of the muscular system

sub_topics.description: The major skeletal muscles, the three types of muscle tissue (skeletal/smooth/cardiac), and agonist/antagonist muscle pairing.

sub_topics.name: 2.10.1 Lever System

competencies.description: Apply lever system in physical activities and sports appropriately

sub_topics.description: The three classes of levers, mechanical advantage, and the principle of moments as applied to sporting movement.

sub_topics.name: 2.11.1 Sport Marketing
sub_topics.description: The marketing mix (Product, Price, Place, Promotion) and target market, applied to a sports event.

sub_topics.name: 2.11.2 Sport Branding

competencies.description: Align specific features of branding in the sports industry correctly

sub_topics.description: Elements of brand identity (name, logo, colour palette, tagline) and brand consistency.
